propositions: A duplicate-closed child with a live replacement link is exempt from the completion-verifier requirement at close time, but the certification path does not honor this exemption and demands a completion-verifier attestation on every closed direct child

The close gate grants dispositions (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) an exemption that skips completion verification minting, but child_closure_findings requires valid completion-verifier attestation on all children, creating an uncertifiable state
A disposition-closed child cannot earn a completion-verifier attestation because reopening and re-closing follows the same exemption branch every time, producing identical unsigned output

The certification path should resolve disposition-closed children through their replacement link (certified iff replacement is certified) rather than demanding an attestation the child is exempt from producing
A non-force remedy exists to certify a duplicate: delete the duplicates link, but this undermines honest documentation of the replacement relationship
